description: A painted interior of a dim room with a slanted drafting table in the foreground. On the pale paper sheet are a drawn circle with overlapping ellipse loops, straight construction lines forming a triangle and cross axes, a metal compass, a metal set square and a wooden ruler. A window with small panes is at the upper left, and a tubular-frame chair sits in the dark background. No people, no visible letters or text, and no frame.
